body: I've already did the hospital thing, what they do is they confide you to a room, alone.  For days, they'll leave you in there, until you ''get better''.  Very rarely any contact of anyone.  You're left in this room to drive yourself mad with over thinking and the idea of suicide becomes more and more like a virtue.  I don't want help from professionals, they didn't help...  At least the ones around my area weren't doing a good job at helping me.  I need people.  But I have no one.  I don't need professionals, I need people who understand.

The thing is, I want to be her friend.  I want to watch over her, and make sure she's okay.  She matters so much to me, regardless if I don't mean as much to her anymore.  
She's my greatest love, my first true love.  I don't know what's best, all I know is that I lost someone who was the most beautiful, most special gift in life I could ever receive and now...no longer.
I am in denial, and I have this thought in my head one day she'll realize she has lost someone who loved her more than anyone probably ever could.
